annotations.title: Get what players say about a game

description: Creative Cult's report on how players received one game: the share of player reviews that recommend it and its date, what players praise and criticise, who the game suits, answers to common questions, and numbered sources. Takes the game's name or its slug from search_games.

game.description: The game's name, such as "Marvel's Wolverine", or its slug.

name: get_game

outputSchema.description: The game's report, or found: false with the closest matches.

recommend.description: The share of player reviews that recommend the game, and the day they were counted.

title: Get what players say about a game
